item.description: - Applications › Updates finds newer versions of your apps from Homebrew, Sparkle update feeds, and the App Store, updates Homebrew apps in place, and checks once a day - Settings can switch the app language between macOS's language, English, and Spanish - Clicking a bar in the Overview's recoverable chart opens that category in Cleanup - Space Lens no longer asks for access to the TV app's library - The sidebar uses sentence case, and empty sizes read 0 bytes
